Any courage mismatch (asymmetric matrix, enemy fixed mid) drives annihilation to exactly 0 across 720 encounters -- confirms implementer's hypothesis: mortal_flee pre-empts annihilation whenever either side's pressure crosses its own flee_thr first; with enemy fixed at mid courage (flee_thr=0.8), enemy always flees before pop reaches <=1. mid-vs-mid and low-vs-low symmetric also = 0 (their flee_thr is low enough that even matched pressure triggers flee first). str_ratio_annih_mean=1.000 and pop_ratio_annih_mean=1.000 confirm annihilation (when it occurs) is genuinely between evenly-matched sides, not 'many-vs-few failed to flee'.
implication_not_judged_by_measurer: Population-wide annihilation rate depends on how often organic warring produces brave-vs-brave same-eff mortal-zone encounters -- likely rare (courage is leader-trait-derived, not uniformly distributed, and matched-eff mortal-zone encounters are themselves a minority).
